answer: Audits are recorded in pulse, queued in oasis, and whisper publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 66 identities per epoch. A farm of 43 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2260 identities would post 2733 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
